description: This file provides security utilities including JWT token encoding/decoding, password hashing and verification, and related cryptographic functions for the device telemetry management platform.

methods.name: str _b64url_encode(b: bytes)
methods.description: Encodes bytes into a URL-safe Base64 string without padding.

methods.name: bytes _b64url_decode(s: str)
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe Base64 string into bytes, adding padding if necessary.

methods.name: str _sign(header_b64: str, payload_b64: str, secret: str)
methods.description: Creates an HMAC SHA-256 signature for the given header and payload base64 strings using the secret.

methods.name: str jwt_encode(payload: Dict[str, Any], secret: str, alg: str = "HS256")
methods.description: Generates a JWT token from payload, secret, and algorithm.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] jwt_decode(token: str, secret: str, alg: str = "HS256")
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, returning the payload if valid.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash of a given password.

methods.name: bool verify_password(password: str, hashed: str)
methods.description: Verifies a password against its bcrypt hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(sub: str, email: str, is_premium: bool, expires_minutes: int)
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with subject, email, premium status, and expiration time.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] verify_token(token: str)
methods.description: Verifies and decodes a JWT token to retrieve its payload.

ctags.name: _sign
ctags.pattern: /^def _sign(header_b64: str, payload_b64: str, secret: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(sub: str, email: str, is_premium: bool, expires_minutes: int) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (sub: str, email: str, is_premium: bool, expires_minutes: int)

ctags.name: jwt_decode
ctags.pattern: /^def jwt_decode(token: str, secret: str, alg: str = "HS256") -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: jwt_encode
ctags.pattern: /^def jwt_encode(payload: Dict[str, Any], secret: str, alg: str = "HS256") -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (payload: Dict[str, Any], secret: str, alg: str = "HS256")
